query:
SELECT m.id, m.room_id, m.user_id, m.body, m.created_at
                       FROM messages m
                       JOIN messages c ON c.id = $2 AND c.room_id = $1
                       WHERE m.room_id = $1
                         AND (m.created_at, m.id) < (c.created_at, c.id)
                       ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
                       LIMIT $3
